exposure: Removal of cervical ripening balloon (CRB) after 6 hours
Removal of cervical ripening balloon (CRB) after 12 hours
cohort: 1704 term pregnancies with a singleton fetus in vertex presentation, excluding those with a previous cesarean delivery, failed ripening with prostaglandins prior to CRB insertion, and any contraindication for vaginal delivery.
finding: Removing a cervical ripening balloon after 6 hours, compared to 12 hours, is associated with reduced cesarean and instrumental delivery rates.
mod_finding: Removing a cervical ripening balloon after 6 hours, compared to 12 hours, is associated with reduced cesarean and instrumental delivery rates.
